title: Fix muscle group boxes showing zero exercises

requirements.text: Fix the WorkoutLibraryPage so that each muscle group section correctly displays its associated exercises. Diagnose and resolve the data mapping/filtering logic that causes exercise counts to show as zero for every muscle group. Ensure exercises are correctly associated with their muscle group and rendered inside the corresponding collapsible section.

quotes: Each muscle group box is showing zero exercises.

acceptanceCriteria: Each muscle group section displays all exercises belonging to that muscle group
No muscle group section shows zero exercises when exercises exist for that group in the backend
Exercise cards render correctly with their name, image/video, and relevant details inside each section

requirements.text: Audit the useQueries.ts hooks and backend query for exercises to ensure the exercise data returned includes the correct muscle group field, and that the frontend filtering/grouping logic in WorkoutLibraryPage correctly matches exercises to their respective muscle group by the same key/ID used in both datasets.

quotes: Each muscle group box is showing zero exercises.

acceptanceCriteria: The muscle group identifier used to group exercises on the frontend matches the identifier returned by the backend for each exercise
The React Query hooks return a non-empty list of exercises when exercises exist in the canister
Console produces no errors related to undefined muscle group fields or failed exercise fetches

constraints: Do not alter frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts
Do not change the backend data schema unless the muscle group field name is confirmed to be the root cause of the mismatch
nonGoals: Adding new exercises or muscle groups
